data.long_meaning: Fullah is an Arabic name derived from the Arabic word ‘fullah’ which means abundance, generosity, and wealth. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name Fullah is a source of blessings and prosperity. The name is mentioned in the Hadith and is considered a virtue in Islam. The name Fullah carries the meaning “Abundance, Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fullah usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's endless blessings and generosity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fullah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
